action.objective: Keep king active and remote from the rook; Kh7 sidesteps checks toward the queenside.
action.rationale: Only commit_ready move. Broad survey scored all king moves about -600 (drawish K+R vs K); Kh7 verified at depth 4 with exact score -600, no immediate mate. Opponent's rook on d5 can give checks but verified safety shows no forced mate in one or short checking chain.
